criteria.criterion: equipment.test.ts: chartDiameter is monotone in pressure for every balloon; NC grows less per atm than SC; every DeviceSpec has sources or modelParam
criteria.evidence: src/simulation/pci/equipment.test.ts 'compliance charts' sweeps every inflatable spec (at least 16) at every diameter from 0 to RBP+4 atm in 0.25 atm steps and asserts non-decreasing diameter, plus label size at nominal within 0.08 mm; 'a non-compliant balloon grows less per atm than a semi-compliant one' checks nc < sc at 2.0 to 4.0 mm and vhp < sc; 'provenance' asserts hasProvenance for every DEVICES, GUIDES and WIRE_SPEC entry and that each source names an existing manual lesson id or docs/ file. DeviceSpec type (equipment.ts lines 478-560) requires sources: string[] and modelParam: true | string[]. All pass.

criteria.criterion: A 2.0 mm burr reports minGuideFr 7; extension inner diameters match the table; covered stents offer exactly the listed diameters
criteria.evidence: Test 'a 2.0 mm burr reports minimum guide 7 Fr' asserts DEVICE_BY_ID.rota.minFrench(2.0) === 7, 6 Fr for 1.25-1.75, 8 Fr for 2.15-2.25, null for 2.38/2.5, and cross-checks against Table 30.4 lumens. 'extension inner diameters match Table 30.5' asserts EXTENSION_ID_IN/EXTENSION_ID_MM for 5, 5.5, 6, 7, 8 Fr, lengths 25/40 cm, and that the box prints the inner diameter; a separate test refuses unlisted sizes (6.5 Fr throws). 'covered stents offer exactly the listed diameters' asserts the two designs only, diameters [2.8,3.5,4.0,4.5,4.8] and [2.5..5.0], lengths, French needs, nominal at least 15 atm, 1.6 mm shortening per end. All pass.

criteria.criterion: boxLabel shows nominal, RBP and expiry for each class
criteria.evidence: Test 'box label: shows nominal, rated burst pressure and expiry for every class' iterates every class and every spec, asserting a 'Use by' line with the given date, 'Nominal pressure' and 'Rated burst pressure' lines with the spec's values for inflatable devices (and no RBP line otherwise), a non-empty chart and a Guide line. A further test checks expired is computed but no 'expired' text is printed on the box (no ground truth on screen). boxLabel implementation at equipment.ts ~1556 matches. All pass.

criteria.criterion: guide.test.ts ordering (EBU > JL, 7 Fr > 6 Fr) still holds
criteria.evidence: src/simulation/pci/guide.test.ts 'back-up follows the published ordering' asserts backupForce(EBU3.5) > backupForce(JL4) and backupForce(JL4 at 7 Fr) > backupForce(JL4 at 6 Fr); 5/5 tests pass. guide.ts GuideState.french is typed GuideFrench (5|6|7|8). equipment.test.ts also checks every EBU backupN > every JL backupN. guide.catalogue.test.ts 4/4 pass.

testsRun: npx vitest run src/simulation/pci/equipment.test.ts src/simulation/pci/guide.test.ts src/simulation/pci/guide.catalogue.test.ts -> 3 files, 34 tests passed (equipment 25, guide 5, guide.catalogue 4)
